svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make eight. Saw UPN 80 channel 3,000 mm long, square ends. It lies

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flanges down: the flat 80 mm web on top, flanges on the pads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rail: 20 mm round bar along the middle of the web, stitch welded

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both sides, 40 mm welds every 250 mm. Grind the joint ends flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End modules: stop the bar 70 mm short of the outer end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fishplates: 6 x 30 x 200 mm flat, one each side across each joint,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two M12 bolts in 14 x 24 mm slots so the joint can slide 6 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pads: 200 x 150 x 10 mm plate, one every 1,000 mm and under each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: joint, bedded level on a thin lime-sand mortar on the wall top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End stops: 8 mm plate box 60 x 80 x 200 mm, rubber face, two M12

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts down through the web at each track end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bar straight within 2 mm over 3 m; tops of the two wall

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tracks level with each other within 5 mm.
